column2: Razorpay IFSC dataset, compiled from RBI's NEFT/RTGS IFSC lists and NPCI member lists
Stated as public domain by its publisher (Razorpay); underlying RBI/NPCI terms not confirmed

A copy of published lists on the date above. Not every branch may be listed: branches open, merge and close, and many co-operative banks use another bank's IFSC (listed under that bank). A code being listed or well-formed doesn't prove it is live. Check the branch with the person you're paying.
